$comment: Direction: Swift to Rust. Protocol 38. The Settings toggle for the question after a block. The service refuses true until this Mac's first 14 days of blocks are over (rating_prompt_settings.available). It never answers the one-time invitation, which has its own message (respond_rating_opt_in): false while the question was never on changes nothing. Answered with rating_prompt_settings only; Swift sends request_work_block_state afterwards if the result view is open, so a question or an invitation the change withdrew leaves the screen. Turning it off hides an open question for good: turning it on again does not bring back a question about a block that started before, and the row expires on its own schedule.
